starting-off.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off.text: Do I look okay? Those kids drive me crazy.

starting-off.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off.text: I'm sorry. It's just that I've lost her.

starting-off.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off.text: Fluffs, poor Fluffs. She never hurt anyone.

starting-off.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off.text: My beloved feline friend Fluffs. She's been purring by my side for almost a decade. Please, could you go search for her while I look over the kids?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Really? Thank you so much! I really have no idea where she could be!

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I think my sons, Shilop and Wilough, saw the cat last. They'll be out in the market place.

steps.player: Alright then, I'll see what I can do.
Sorry, I'm too busy to play pet rescue.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Well, okay then. I'll have to find someone else.

starting-off-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Have you seen my poor Fluffs?

starting-off-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
starting-off-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Hmmm...strange, he should be at the market.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.player: Hello there, I've been looking for you.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.speaker: Wilough/Shilop
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.text: I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.player: What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.speaker: Wilough
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.text: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.speaker: Wilough
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough.text: If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.

options.text: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.

steps.player: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.

options.text: What will make you tell me?

steps.player: What will make you tell me?

steps.speaker: Shilop
steps.text: Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.

steps.player: 100 coins! Why should I pay you?

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?

options.text: I'm not paying you a penny.

steps.player: I'm not paying you a penny.

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.

steps.player: There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: I play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.

options.text: Well never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.

steps.player: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.

steps.speaker: Wilough
steps.text: I'm sure my mum will get over it.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.player: Where did you say you saw Fluffs?

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.speaker: Wilough
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.text: Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.text: Hello again, did you manage to find Shilop? I can't keep an eye on him for the life of me.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.player: He does seem quite a handful.

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.text: You have no idea! Did he help at all?

talking-to-shilop-and-wilough-talking-to.player: I think so, I'm just going to look now.

finding-fluffs-talking-to-shilop-and-wil.speaker: Shilop
finding-fluffs-talking-to-shilop-and-wil.text: You think you're tough do you?
The boy begins to jump around with his fists up. You decide it's best not to kill him just yet.

finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Hello. How's it going? Any luck?

finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Well well, you are clever! Did you bring her back?

finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.player: Well, that's the thing, she refuses to leave.

finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Oh dear, oh dear! Maybe she's just hungry. She loves doogle sardines but I'm all out.

finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.speaker: Gertrude
finding-fluffs-talking-to-gertrude-again.text: Yes, raw sardines seasoned with doogle leaves. Unfortunately I've used all my doogle leaves, but you may find some in the woods out back.

making-seasoned-sardines.text: You rub the doogle leaves all over the sardines.

making-seasoned-sardines-pick-up-fluffs.text: The cat seems afraid to leave. In the distance you can hear kittens mewing...

making-seasoned-sardines-talking-to-gert.speaker: Gertrude
making-seasoned-sardines-talking-to-gert.text: Hey traveller, did Fluffs eat the sardines?

making-seasoned-sardines-talking-to-gert.player: Yeah, she loved them, but she still won't leave.

making-seasoned-sardines-talking-to-gert.speaker: Gertrude
making-seasoned-sardines-talking-to-gert.text: Well that is strange, there must be a reason.

making-seasoned-sardines-searching-crate.text: You find a kitten! You carefully place it in your backpack.

making-seasoned-sardines-returning-the-k.text: Fluffs has run off home with her offsping.

finishing-up.player: Hello Gertrude. Fluffs ran off with her kitten.

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: You're back! Thank you! Thank you! Fluffs just came back! I think she was just upset as she couldn't find her kitten.

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: If you hadn't found her kitten it would have died out there!

finishing-up.player: That's okay, I like to do my bit.

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: I don't know how to thank you. I have no real material possessions. I do have kittens! I can only really look after one.

finishing-up.player: Well, if it needs a home.

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: I would sell it to my cousin in West Ardougne. I hear there's a rat epidemic there. But it's too far.

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: Here you go, look after her and thank you again!

finishing-up.speaker: Gertrude
finishing-up.text: Oh by the way, the kitten can live in your backpack, but to make it grow you must take it out and feed and stroke it often.
